analogy.rationale: HDAC inhibitors block histone deacetylation, broadly de-repressing chromatin and altering expression of large gene sets, so other epigenetic modifiers (DNMT and HMT inhibitors) should give the most similar transcriptional signatures; MDM2 is an annotated target and MDM inhibitors plus HSP/proteasome inhibitors share downstream stress and chromatin-related programs.
